svg.title: Regions of absolute stability in the plane of z = h times lambda
svg.desc: Seven panels. Shaded: a decaying or growing mode does not grow in the computation. Forward Euler is stable only inside a unit disc at minus one. Backward Euler, BDF2 and TR-BDF2 are stable everywhere outside a closed region in the right half-plane. The trapezoidal rule is stable exactly in the left half-plane. The boundary of BDF3 crosses the imaginary axis into the left half-plane by at most 0.083.
